description_en: Modifies attributes of an instance group
description_zh: 修改云手机实例组的信息
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic modify-android-instance-group --instance-group-id ag-cuv4scs4obxhs0000 --new-instance-group-name newName --policy-group-id pg-2w97kp89gnsif0000 --stream-mode 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAndroidInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance group
parameters.name: instance_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the instance group.

The name can be up to 30 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-). It must start with letters but cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh:
实例组的新名称。


实例组名称长度不超过30个字符；请以大/小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头，仅支持中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、点号（.）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: new_instance_group_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies the streaming mode for instances within the instance group. If this parameter is omitted, the mode defaults to 1 (Preemptive)
parameters.help_zh: 实例组下实例的串流模式，该参数不传默认为抢占模式
parameters.name: stream_mode
